description: This PHP source file defines the class ProjectCoreCompatibility, which manages core compatibility messages for Drupal project releases, including version checks, message creation, and compatibility range calculations.

classes.name: ProjectCoreCompatibility
classes.description: A utility class for managing Drupal core compatibility messages and version ranges for project releases.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with core data, available releases, and supported branches.

methods.name: getPossibleCoreUpdateVersions
methods.description: Determines which core versions are available for update based on current version and supported branches.

methods.name: setReleaseMessage
methods.description: Sets core compatibility messages for project release data.

methods.name: isCoreCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a given core version constraint is compatible with the installed core version.

methods.name: createMessageFromCoreCompatibility
methods.description: Creates a human-readable message from a core version constraint.

methods.name: getCompatibilityRanges
methods.description: Calculates version ranges compatible with a given semantic version constraint.
